en-US.author: Luis Pater
en-US.description: Wrap Gemini CLI, ChatGPT Codex as an OpenAI/Gemini/Claude compatible API service, allowing you to enjoy the free Gemini 2.5 Pro, GPT 5 model through API
en-US.longDescription:
A proxy server that provides OpenAI/Gemini/Claude compatible API interfaces for CLI.
It now also supports OpenAI Codex (GPT models) and Claude Code via OAuth.
so you can use local or multi‑account CLI access with OpenAI‑compatible clients and SDKs.
Now, We added the first Chinese provider: Qwen Code.
en-US.name: CLI Proxy API
en-US.releaseNotes:
Linux release assets
- CLIProxyAPI_<version>_linux_<arch>.tar.gz is the default Linux build. It supports dynamic library plugins and is built against a GLIBC 2.17 baseline.
- CLIProxyAPI_<version>_linux_<arch>_no-plugin.tar.gz is the portable Linux build for musl-based or older systems such as OpenWrt. It does not support dynamic library plugins.
FreeBSD release assets
- CLIProxyAPI_<version>_freebsd_aarch64_no-plugin.tar.gz is the FreeBSD arm64 build. It is built without CGO and does not support dynamic library plugins.
Changelog
- docs(config): document X-Session-ID guidance for full-history compaction under session affinity (84534584)
- fix(thinking): recognize claude thinking.display updates in summary pipeline (13fdcc5e)
- fix(home): only renew liveness on heartbeat pong (c9dad847)
- fix(usage,auth): propagate request-scoped error rule classification to usage fail.code (18883a57)
- Merge pull request #7397 from sususu98/fix/request-scoped-errors-usage-fail-code (40e5a40f)
- fix(openai): inject placeholder reasoning_content for compat Claude tool calls (0e0cab0d)
- Merge pull request #7403 from router-for-me/home (1855209d)
- fix(openai): start responses websocket keepalive after upgrade (46d48eb5)
- fix(claude): embed tool schemas with rejected property names in descriptions (f0c9c2d0)
- fix(codex): support local compaction for compatible Responses endpoints (61f1ad5e)
- fix(compaction): strip text format constraints and configuration_update from summary requests (d576416a)
- fix(claude): treat cli-bg x-app header as native claude code client (6876a2eb)
- Merge pull request #7413 from sususu98/feat/codex-compat-compaction-7406 (905637da)
What's Changed
- fix(usage,auth): propagate request-scoped error rule classification to usage fail.code by @sususu98 in https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI/pull/7397
- fix(home): only renew liveness on heartbeat pong by @hkfires in https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI/pull/7403
- fix(codex): support local compaction for compatible Responses endpoints by @sususu98 in https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI/pull/7413
Full Changelog: https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI/compare/v8.0.63...v8.0.64

zh-CN.description: 封装 Gemini CLI 和 ChatGPT Codex 为兼容 OpenAI/Gemini/Claude 的 API 服务，让您通过 API 畅享免费的 Gemini 2.5 Pro 和 GPT 5 模型
zh-CN.longDescription:
一个为 CLI 提供 OpenAI/Gemini/Claude 兼容 API 接口的代理服务器。
现已支持通过 OAuth 登录接入 OpenAI Codex（GPT 系列）和 Claude Code。
可与本地或多账户方式配合，使用任何 OpenAI 兼容的客户端与 SDK。
现在，我们添加了第一个中国提供商：Qwen Code。
